summary: One of two product pages (global employment, managed outsourcing) that share a template of about nine blocks: a photo head on orange line-art, a six-item fit list, a services card, a how-it-works panel with a responsibility meter, a call-to-action and case studies. Needs a six-item fit list, a split of who handles what (recruitment, HR, management) and key benefit tags.
